tasks.name: Story 5.1: Tutorial and Onboarding Experience
tasks.description: Execute the complete BMAD (Business, Management, Architecture, Development) lifecycle for Story 5.1: Tutorial and Onboarding Experience by running three sequential sub-agents: bmad-sm-draft-story for story management, bmad-dev-develop-story for development implementation, and bmad-qa-review-story for quality assurance review. This coordinates the systematic development of a comprehensive tutorial and onboarding experience for new players of the 2048 game, including interactive tutorial overlays, step-by-step gameplay instruction, onboarding flow integration, tutorial state management, user progress tracking, skip tutorial option, accessibility compliance for tutorial elements, and complete tutorial testing across all supported platforms.
tasks.notes: This task coordinates the complete BMAD workflow for Story 5.1 implementation. The tutorial system must integrate with existing Epic 4 gesture recognition, follow established React Native Reanimated 3 animation patterns, use Expo Router for navigation, maintain consistency with ThemedText/ThemedView components, implement AsyncStorage persistence patterns, and ensure WCAG AA accessibility compliance.

tasks.analysisResult: Story 5.1 requires implementing a comprehensive tutorial and onboarding experience for the 2048 game using established React Native/Expo patterns. The implementation must follow existing component templates, theming system, animation patterns with React Native Reanimated 3, and Expo Router navigation. The tutorial system should be self-contained while integrating seamlessly with existing architecture including AsyncStorage persistence, accessibility compliance, and platform-specific presentations.

tasks.name: Story 5.2: Game Over and Victory Screens
tasks.description: Execute the complete BMAD (Business, Management, Architecture, Development) lifecycle for Story 5.2: Game Over and Victory Screens by running three sequential sub-agents: bmad-sm-draft-story for story management, bmad-dev-develop-story for development implementation, and bmad-qa-review-story for quality assurance review. This coordinates the systematic development of clear feedback when games end with game over overlay displaying final score and performance feedback, victory screen with celebration animation when reaching 2048 tile, continue playing option after victory, new game and restart options, score comparison with previous best score and progress indicators, smooth transitions between game states with proper animation, and game end screen testing with various score scenarios and outcomes.
tasks.notes: This task coordinates the complete BMAD workflow for Story 5.2 implementation. The game end screens must integrate with Epic 2 game logic for win/lose detection, Epic 3 scoring system for final score calculation, follow established Expo Router modal patterns, use React Native Reanimated 3 for celebration animations, implement AsyncStorage for best score persistence, and ensure smooth state transitions with accessibility compliance.
